svg.title: Public-goods funding application workflow
svg.desc: An ongoing-funding application of the broader Decentralized Curation framework. Nominations remain subject to accuracy challenges while relevance juries and appeals produce scores that determine eligible funding weights, accrual and beneficiary claims.
svg.text: An application of the Decentralized Curation framework.
Can the factual claims withstand challenge?
How much does it matter under the policy?

text.tspan: Request a weight; post the bond
Curators stake to join the draw
Split the flow by eligible weights

svg.text: Earned funds remain owed, paid or unclaimed.
Protocol steps execute through calls, not an autonomous evaluator. Quorum: timely valid reveals cover at least 80% of original drawn weight.
Nonempty draw required. Appeal retries keep their target without a limit. Sole-funded positions: full refund, no fee or profit; forfeiture is not consensus.
Utility token: jury stake and coherence. Ether (ETH): service fees, funding and financial positions. Agreement is not proof of truth or public benefit.
